Download task added. Track progress in the bottom-right corner.
Read this before you use the launcher
Report a bug or share an idea

[Login fixes]
- Fixed Microsoft (premium) login: replaced the working device-code client_id.
- Fixed external (authlib) login: strip duplicate /authserver path that caused 404.
- Fixed LittleSkin one-tap login: resolve the real auth URL and fix a main-thread network crash.

[Crash fixes]
- Fixed Unknown screen crash when opening download tasks.

[Experience]
- Long-press Start Game for mod crash diagnosis (missing deps / conflicts / duplicates).
- Stronger in-game text contrast; fixed random 60fps lock.
- Adaptive power: idle locks 60Hz, touch restores high refresh (toggle in Settings, on by default).
- Liquid-bubble loading animation; liquid-glass dock capsule with inertia stretch.
- Fixed wallpaper-switch freeze; download-task notification on new version download.
- Home entry added to dock; background opacity locked to 0 under liquid glass, default 50 for solid.
